_why: Schema fixture, apps.json (the app registry) at schemaVersion 2 — one entry with every field the version defines, at the values the writer emits for a fresh app. Read by BOTH halves of the contract: the app's vitest parses it through the real registry reader (app/src/host/contract/fixtures.test.ts) and `nix flake check` maps every entry through platform/lib/registry-lib.nix (nix/tests/fixtures.nix). fixtures/site/v1/apps.json is a COPY of this file (a link would not survive the store copy a nix path literal makes), and both readers assert the two are equal. A version bump adds a sibling directory and leaves this one as it was written.

presentation.description: A documentation app: every field of the v2 entry, once.
